name.full: Resemble AI Authenticity and Signal for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Check media authenticity and screen web content for fraud with Resemble Signal.
description.full: Analyze audio, images, video, and text for synthetic content, and screen retrieved public web content or selected text/media for fraud patterns with Resemble Signal. The web-fraud-check skill guides screening before using web sources and reports what was actually checked. Cowork chooses skills contextually; this plugin cannot intercept every web fetch or enforce a universal security gate. Submit media, retrieve detection results, and ask grounded follow-up questions. Requires a Resemble account with the requested capabilities; analyses may consume credits and Signal stores team submissions. Results are probabilistic: safe means no strong match to configured categories, not verified facts, website safety, identity, or absence of prompt injection.

agentConnectors.description: Authenticated authenticity analysis and Signal fraud screening of retrieved web content or selected media.
